name: Milpitas Recreation Leader (part-time, ages 16+)
org: City of Milpitas Recreation and Community Services
what_you_do: Lead games, activities and homework help for kids in after school programs (After the Bell and LYFE), summer day camps, special events and the Milpitas Teen Center.
who_can_apply: At least 16 at the time of hire. You must have some experience working with school age kids (ages 5-12).
duration: Part-time, year-round and seasonal. Usually Monday to Friday, 2 to 6 pm, with some nights, weekends and holidays. Up to 1,000 hours a year.
deadline_text: Opened May 5, 2026. Open until filled and may close at any time. Applications are screened on a regular basis.
how_to_apply: Apply online at governmentjobs.com/careers/milpitas. The city's Rec Leader page also lets you mail a paper application and resume to the Milpitas Community Center, 457 E Calaveras Blvd. Questions: 408-586-3210.
notes: You need a TB test and Red Cross First Aid and CPR within 60 days of hire. Fingerprints are only required if you are 18 or older. Perks include a free Milpitas Sports Center membership and paid sick leave after 90 days.
